intro: Keep your certificates in one place. We’ll remind you before anything runs out, and you can send them to an organizer in one go.

check.footer: The previous certificate is kept as history. Your files are private: only you, and organizers you send them to, can see them.

warnings.expired: This expired on {date}. You can still save it, but organizers will see that it has expired.

send.title: Send to organizer
send.footer: If you renew a certificate, the organizer’s link shows the new one automatically. You’ll see when they open it.

sent.turnOffConfirm: Turn off this link? The organizer won’t be able to open it anymore.
